The company previously said the VR headset will launch this summer, but hasn’t offered a specific timeframe. It’s been a long wait for the Steam Frame VR gaming headset following its announcement late last year. Valve finally gave us a summer launch timeline for this eagerly anticipated device in June, but we haven’t heard much since then. But pairing the Pixel 11 Pro with just 12GB of RAM , down from 16GB last year, undermines its high-end AI credentials. Meanwhile, Google has dropped a CPU core from its configuration, reducing the benefits of its more modern architecture. While we can’t blame Google for the current state of the global RAM supply chain, its decision to switch to yet another mid-range graphics chip is harder to defend.
